entries.condition: fixed reference camera, still_grid vs reference_a

entries.evidence: Measured aircraft span ~0.28-0.295 of frame width (yellow/white mask), reference 0.232; centroid (0.77,0.73) vs (0.77,0.74).
entries.defect: Aircraft rendered ~20-27% larger than the reference at the same camera.
entries.fix: Reduce aircraft scale or move the fixed camera back so span reaches 0.232.

entries.condition: still, direct sun, paint at distance
entries.evidence: White wing reads 235-240 (sunlit correct), yellow tips saturated; no visible highlight roll-off or panel variation at this distance.
entries.defect: Paint is a single flat albedo with no specular response.
entries.fix: Add clearcoat-style specular with roughness variation and panel/rivet normal detail.

entries.evidence: Cabin glazing reads as a uniform dark grey block on the fuselage top with no sun glint.

entries.evidence: Downtown massing at B3-D3 is plausible with varied heights; second city at G3-H3 is pale uniform boxes; suburb A3 is a flat pale texture plane.

entries.evidence: Island outline is close to the reference's largest island; beach is a uniform bright ring (216,205,182) of constant width around the whole island.

entries.evidence: No cloud or sky reflections in the water; the lagoon at D6 has a flat cyan fill.
